why: The student uses the right approach, an element-by-element loop copying data2[i] into copy[i]. The code is wrong in two ways. The condition i <= data2.length runs one index past the end and throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The answer also never creates the copy array with new int[data2.length]. These are slips in an otherwise sound structure, so this is L2 with an error. It is not a correct, extended solution.
